canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 39,879 FHA applications Newrez Llc acted on ended without a credit decision: 21.0% withdrawn by the applicant and 21.9% closed for incompleteness.

required_qualifiers.population: Newrez Llc FHA applications acted on (actions 1-5: originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, closed for incompleteness; purchased loans and preapproval requests excluded; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate; process, market, applicant pool and reporting practice are not separable in the record

does_not_establish: that Newrez Llc's process causes applicants to withdraw, or that its applicants cause files to close
that Newrez Llc is better or worse than another lender for a given applicant
Newrez Llc discriminates or violates law
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
